name: envhue
displayName: Envhue – Never Mistake PROD for DEV
description: Color and protect your VS Code windows by environment (DEV, TEST, PREPROD, PROD): colors, window title, confirmation and optional read-only mode for local, SSH, WSL and Dev Container folders.

commands.title: Envhue: Import from Project Manager and Peacock
Envhue: Apply Colors to This Workspace
Envhue: Change Colors of the Current Environment
Envhue: Reset Colors in All Environments
Envhue: Reset Colors and Read-Only Lock

envhue.showOnStartup.description: Show the environment picker when VS Code starts.

envhue.autoApplyColors.description: Apply the colors of the registered environment automatically whenever its folder is open, however it was opened.

envhue.tintBackgrounds.description: Also tint the editor, side bar, panel and terminal backgrounds. Turn off to color only the title bar, activity bar and status bar (recommended with light themes).

envhue.windowTitlePrefix.description: Prefix the window title with the environment type, for example "[PROD]". It also appears in the taskbar and is useful for color-blind users.

envhue.detectProduction.description: Offer to register an open folder as PROD when it is not registered but its host, folder or name contains the word "prod" (or "production").

envhue.terminalAlert.description: Warn when a command that looks like it changes files, services or data runs in the terminal of a read-only environment. Read-only mode does not cover the terminal, and this alert cannot stop the command. Needs VS Code 1.93+ with terminal shell integration.

envhue.openRemoteInNewWindow.description: Open SSH, WSL and Dev Container environments in a new window, so that a failed connection (for example a cancelled password prompt) never replaces the current window.

envhue.openInNewWindow.description: Open the selected environment in a new window instead of replacing the current one.

envhue.environments.description: Environment definitions. Only name, path and type are required; colors are derived from the accent when omitted.

id.description: Optional. A stable id is generated when omitted.

connection.description: local: a folder on this machine. ssh: a folder reached through Remote - SSH (set "server"). wsl: a folder in a WSL distribution (set "distro"). devcontainer: a local folder reopened in its dev container.

server.description: SSH host or alias known to Remote - SSH.

text.description: Text drawn on the accent color. Chosen automatically (black or white) when omitted.

readOnly.description: Open this environment in read-only mode: files are locked in the editor and Explorer until you unlock them for the session (Envhue: Toggle Read-Only Mode). A reminder stays visible in the status bar and the window title. The terminal is not affected.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/colors.test.js out/test/normalize.test.js out/test/sshConfig.test.js out/test/connections.test.js out/test/projectImport.test.js out/test/cleanup.test.js out/test/panel.test.js out/test/equal.test.js out/test/groups.test.js
